sections.html: HOLIDAY IS A CONTEMPORARY SAUCE BRAND DEVELOPED TO REFRAME EVERYDAY CONDIMENTS AS EXPRESSIVE, LIFESTYLE DRIVEN OBJECTS. POSITIONED BETWEEN FOOD AND FASHION, THE BRAND DRAWS ON EDITORIAL IMAGERY, BOLD COLOUR PALETTES, AND PLAYFUL NARRATIVE TO CREATE A DISTINCTIVE AND MEMORABLE IDENTITY. AT THE CORE OF THE PROJECT IS A CONTRAST BETWEEN REFINEMENT AND HUMOUR. A CLASSIC SERIF MONOGRAM AND ELEGANT TYPOGRAPHIC SYSTEM ARE PAIRED WITH UNEXPECTED ILLUSTRATIONS AND SURREAL VISUAL ELEMENTS, SUCH AS THE LOBSTER MOTIF AND STYLISED CHARACTER WORK. THIS JUXTAPOSITION CREATES A BRAND THAT FEELS BOTH PREMIUM AND IRREVERENT.
